name: split-detail-table
title: Table with Split Detail Panel
description: Support ticket queue where a ticket opens in a side panel that pushes the table aside: edit status, priority and assignee, reply, and step to the previous or next ticket while the table keeps its filter, sort, page and scroll.

files.content:
export const statuses = ['open', 'pending', 'solved'] as const
export type Status = (typeof statuses)[number]

export const priorities = ['urgent', 'high', 'normal', 'low'] as const
export type Priority = (typeof priorities)[number]

export const agents = [
  'Unassigned',
  'Nadia Rahman',
  'Tomás Silva',
  'Grace Lee',
] as const
export type Agent = (typeof agents)[number]

export interface Message {
  from: 'customer' | 'agent'
  author: string
  /** "2026-11-17T09:40", in the help desk's time zone */
  at: string
  body: string
}

export interface Ticket {
  id: string
  subject: string
  customer: { name: string; company: string; email: string }
  status: Status
  priority: Priority
  assignee: Agent
  created: string
  updated: string
  messages: Message[]
}

/** The demo's "now", fixed so the server and browser show the same times */
export const NOW = '2026-11-17T15:00'

type Seed = [
  subject: string,
  name: string,
  company: string,
  status: Status,
  priority: Priority,
  assignee: Agent,
  created: string,

const slug = (company: string) => company.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g, '')

export const tickets: Ticket[] = seeds.map(
  (
    [
      subject,
      name,
      company,
      status,
      priority,
      assignee,
      created,
      updated,
      question,
      answer,
    ],
    i,
  ) => ({
    id: `TCK-${1040 + i}`,
    subject,
    customer: {
      name,
      company,
      email: `${name.split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()}@${slug(company)}.example`,
    },
    status,
    priority,
    assignee,
    created,
    updated,
    messages: [
      { from: 'customer', author: name, at: created, body: question },
      ...(answer
        ? [
            {
              from: 'agent' as const,
              author: assignee === 'Unassigned' ? 'Support' : assignee,
              at: updated,
              body: answer,
            },
          ]
        : []),
    ],
  }),
)
